evidence_items.finding: weekly net surplus is noticeably lower than two years ago despite customer volumes remaining similar
evidence_items.rationale: Lower surplus with stable volume is a critical margin erosion signal. financial_health dimension; is_critical=true. No must_identify vocabulary used.

evidence_items.finding: ingredient and packaging costs have risen significantly over the past 24 months
evidence_items.rationale: Input cost inflation is a critical adverse margin signal. financial_health dimension; is_critical=true. No must_identify terms used.

evidence_items.finding: the owner has absorbed rising costs without adjusting what customers are charged
evidence_items.rationale: Cost absorption without recovery is a margin erosion mechanism. No must_identify vocabulary used.

evidence_items.finding: catering booking volume is slightly below last year but the owner cannot measure its financial impact separately
evidence_items.rationale: Soft catering bookings as a secondary signal — included at LOW confidence because the primary margin driver is input cost, not catering volume.

evidence_items.finding: annual revenue AUD 780K; 9 staff; café selling prices have not been updated in three years; catering arm operates alongside café
evidence_items.rationale: Three-year price freeze with rising ingredient costs confirms the margin erosion mechanism. is_critical=true. No must_identify terms used.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): catering booking volume is slightly below last year and owner attributes the entire surplus decline to this
evidence_items.rationale: Catering softness is a misleading partial signal — it cannot explain a multi-year sustained margin decline on its own. Non-critical, LOW confidence.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): customer numbers through the café have remained broadly stable
evidence_items.rationale: Stable customer count is a misleading signal when the problem is cost margin not volume. Non-critical, LOW confidence.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): a nearby competitor café closed recently potentially increasing foot traffic
evidence_items.rationale: Competitor closure is a misleading demand signal when the problem is input cost not volume. Non-critical, LOW confidence.

metric_key_mappings.transform_note: Proxy: ingredient cost inflation over 24 months without any price adjustment in a food service business typically produces a 15-25% shift in direct cost percentage. -18 used as a conservative estimate to signal material margin erosion direction to the engine.

clarification_requests.would_improve_pattern: fin_isMarginErosion (confirmed ingredient cost percentage versus three years ago elevates confidence)

validation_notes: SIM-03-002 is a margin erosion case driven by food cost inflation not recovered through menu repricing. No must_identify vocabulary used (food cost as proportion of revenue, menu pricing not reviewed, cost absorption without recovery, direct costs rising against stable selling prices, margin erosion over time — none appear in findings). Negative marginPct proxy signals erosion direction.
